summary: Hansjakob Seiler was a linguist who studied under Manu Leumann around 1940–1947. He held a post at the University of Cologne from approximately 1959 to 1986.

Hanung Kim works in the fields of Tibetology, history, and archaeology. Kim earned a Master's degree from Columbia University and completed a PhD at Harvard University under the supervision of Leonard van der Kuijp.

Har Bilas Sarda was an Indology, history, and archaeology scholar who studied at the University of Calcutta from around 1884 to 1888. He served as a judge at the Court of Small Causes, Ajmer, from circa 1913 to 1923.
Har Dayal was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar. He studied at the University of Delhi around 1899–1903 and at SOAS University of London between roughly 1927 and 1932.

Har Dutt Sharma was an Indologist who completed his doctoral studies under Moriz Winternitz. He served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of Delhi and held a post at Hindu College, Delhi (attested 1957).

Hara Prasad Sastri worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, history, and archaeology, and taught Surendranath Majumdar Sastri. He served as Principal of Sanskrit College and University (attested 1905) and Joint Philological Secretary at The Asiatic Society (attested 1905–1911).

Harabhadra Sastri was an Indology scholar who held a post at the Research and Archaeological Department, Jammu and Kashmir, where he was attested as a Pandit in 1918 and further attested in 1922 and 1945.
Harabhatha Shastri was an Indologist who held a post at the Research and Archaeological Department, Jammu and Kashmir, where he was attested in 1911 and as a Pandit in 1916.

Harald Christian Rasmussen was an Indologist who studied under Michael Viggo Fausbøll at the University of Copenhagen, earning a kand.theol. and a Ph.D. He held schoolteacher, Senior Teacher, and Skoleinspektør posts at De forenede Kirkeskoler between 1875 and 1889.

Harald Hauptmann worked in archaeology, history, and Iranian/Central Asian studies, earning degrees from Heidelberg and FU Berlin. His career included roles at the German Archaeological Institute, Heidelberg University, and the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

Harald Hundius worked in Buddhist studies and linguistics, studying under Singkha Wannasai. He was a lecturer at Chiang Mai University in 1983 and a professor at the University of Passau from around 1993 to 2004.
Harald Wiese is an Indologist who earned his Dr. habil. at the University of Leipzig, where he became a professor in 1994.

Haraprasad Shastri studied at Sanskrit College and Presidency University. A scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and history, he served as Principal of Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Head of Sanskrit at Presidency, and Professor and Department Head at the University of Dhaka.

Hari Damodar Velankar was an Indologist who studied under Hari Mahadev Bhadkamkar. He served as Professor of Sanskrit at Wilson College, Mumbai (attested 1944–1948) and Joint Director at Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (attested 1959–1960).

Hari Pratap Kailash works in philosophy and Indology. He earned an MBBS from AIIMS, New Delhi (2000–2005), an MA from Jawaharlal Nehru University (2008–2010), and a PhD from the University of Delhi (2010–2015).

Hari Shankar Prasad is a scholar in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at Banaras Hindu University, under Ramakant Tripathi, and completed his doctoral studies under Jan Willem de Jong (attested 1982).

Haridas Bhattacharyya studied at Scottish Church College and the University of Calcutta. A scholar of philosophy and religious studies, he taught at Scottish Church College, the University of Calcutta, the University of Dhaka, and Banaras Hindu University.
Harikrishna Sharma K. N. is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He was an Assistant Professor at V.T.B. College from 2011 to 2012 and at Sree Sankara College in 2012.

Harish Chandra Gupta worked in Indology and Tibetology. He held a post at the National Library of India (attested 1970), graduated from Government College Sanjauli, and later worked at NEERI, Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, and multiple engineering colleges.
Harish Chandra Mani Tripathi is an Indologist who studied under Karunapati Tripathi. He served as Publication Officer at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1996).
